## Case Studies
- [GreenHeart Organics](https://wpswings.com/case-studies/greenheart-organics/): Greenheart Organics is an online organic food \& waste\-free living store that provides quality, locally sourced products\. They had issues related to the allocation of points per product\. They introduced our “Points For Every Purchase” functionality and saw an immediate spike in conversion rates and retained users\.
- [Beauty \& Care](https://wpswings.com/case-studies/beauty-and-care/): Beauty \& Care is a European wellness and fragrance company dedicated to curating captivating sensory experiences through high\-end essential oils, sauna aromas, and body care products\. They implemented our Points \& Rewards Plugin, and we developed a custom cart \& checkout page for their customers to redeem points as special gifts\!
- [Therapy Online](https://wpswings.com/case-studies/therapyonline/): Therapy Online Saved a Huge Amount of Time and Reduced all Manual Data Entry Errors, And Achieved a 100% Order Accuracy With Our Zoho WooCommerce Integration Plugin\.
- [Uniq Gold](https://wpswings.com/case-studies/uniqgold/): Uniq Gold Store is a luxury jewellery eCommerce store that brings together 18K gold and real diamond creations from iconic designers\. They introduced our “Referral Points” and saw an instant hike in their conversion rates and retention of users\.
- [AssaX Store](https://wpswings.com/case-studies/assaxstore/): AssaX Store is an online platform that specializes in offering in\-game purchases for various video games\. They increased their conversion rate by 30% after implementing our Wallet System for WooCommerce plugin\.
